avoid: Going to the raw material or the real thing itself, today: a fossil, a meteorite, a sound or wire sculpture made now, a found natural object. The first four wildcards (Eno, Dino, Scherenschnitt, the Moon) all made that same move.

menu.sideways: Go sideways: the same subject made by a tradition on another continent that never touched this line, in that tradition's own medium.
menu.forward: Go forward instead of back: the next step this line has not taken yet, a plausible object from a future tradition.
menu.scene: Break the single-object framing: a whole working scene, several objects in use together on the catalogue backdrop.
menu.absence: Show the absence: the trace the object leaves when it is gone (a stain, an empty stand or case, a worn ring, a mould), made with real craft.
menu.hybrid: Merge two of the steps into one plausible object that never existed, as if craftspeople of both eras had made it together.
menu.inspired: Turn the trail around: something this guardian's line later inspired, outside its own medium.
menu.scale: Change the scale: a tiny or monumental version, its scale made obvious within the catalogue framing.
menu.essence: Break the essence: keep one step's look and craft exactly, but give it a different subject that still rhymes with the guardian.
menu.inside: Show the inside: the object opened up, an X-ray, or the maker's or conservator's view of how it works.
menu.copy: A copy: a forgery, souvenir or student copy of one of the steps, made a century later and honest about being a copy.
